name: Dancing In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that dancing is a heartfelt expression of joy and praise to God, as seen when Miriam led the women with timbrels and dances after deliverance (Exodus 15:20). The Psalms encourage praising God's name through dance accompanied by musical instruments (Psalms 149:3; 150:4), and celebrate the transformation from mourning to gladness, highlighting God’s power to turn sorrow into rejoicing (Psalms 30:11; Jeremiah 31:13). Ecclesiastes acknowledges that there is a divinely appointed time for dancing, signifying a season of celebration and laughter amid life's changing circumstances (Ecclesiastes 3:4).
